name: @pipeworx/mcp-michigan-code

tools.name: mi_compiled_law
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Michigan Compiled Laws — Michigan state statutes — by citation. "MCL 750.316" is first degree murder. Returns the statutory text only: the catchline and body of the section. The History line (acts that enacted or amended it) and editorial notes are not included in the stored copy; the `text_scope` field says what a given answer contains. Keyless. Use for "what does MCL 750.316 say" or to check a Michigan statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "750.316" or "257.625". Chapter is the part before the dot.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-michigan-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the michigan-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
